description: German employment law, Germany only: deadlines for parental leave (Elternzeit, §§ 15 to 18 BEEG). Returns the last day the request must reach the employer (7 weeks, 13 weeks after the 3rd birthday), the required form, start and end of protection against dismissal (Kündigungsschutz), the end of maternity protection for the mother and the possible cut of annual leave (Urlaubskürzung). Use it when an employee announces parental leave or a request has arrived.

antrag_zugang.description: Day the request reached the employer, optional (YYYY-MM-DD)

beschaeftigte.description: Employees without apprentices, optional, decides the claim to part-time (more than 15)

elternteil.description: Who takes the leave: mutter (mother) or anderer (father or other parent). Default anderer

errechneter_termin.description: Mother only, child born: expected date of delivery if the child came early, extends maternity protection (YYYY-MM-DD)

geburt.description: Child's date of birth, or the expected date if not born yet (YYYY-MM-DD)

jahresurlaub.description: Annual leave in days, optional, for the possible cut

mutterschutz_12_wochen.description: Mother only: premature or multiple birth or disability, maternity protection 12 instead of 8 weeks after birth

noch_nicht_geboren.description: true if the child is not born yet, geburt is then the expected date

teilzeit.description: Employee works part-time for you during parental leave

name: elternzeit_fristen

ergebnis.description: Result of the tool; its fields differ per tool
